CustomField.description: Cross-object formula surfacing the related RecordAlertCategory's label (Red/Yellow/Green). Added because Flow's Get Records queriedFields cannot reliably traverse RecordAlertCategoryId to RecordAlertCategory.MasterLabel for a datatable-bound collection (confirmed via Tooling API: the relationship reference silently serializes to a placeholder instead of erroring). A formula field evaluates the same cross-object reference natively at the database layer, sidestepping that Flow limitation.
CustomField.label: Category
